outcome: The MIS Reports page is live: an authenticated user picks Agriculture / Nursery / DUB / a loaded period, presses Generate, and sees the governed DUB nursery slice from real SAP data - the resolved scope (7 cost centres, 28 GL codes, nursery-mis-financial-v1), the totals, 28 GL rows by month, and the unmapped-GL bucket as a reviewable list carrying an Actual and a Budget amount per GL with the reason each one is unmapped. That list is the artifact that goes to Srihari to get the authoritative mapping back.
